author: ClubberNugget
body:
Poseidon in the walls is way too powerful.

First:
you cannot be killed while in the water, the regen needs to be lowered, a large amount.  

second, remove the fishing rod. unless you lower the regen even more, you cannot beat a Poseidon, matter the map.

Thanks
